
About UsTeladoc Health Canada is a virtual care provider that proudly serves over 9 million Canadians from coast to coast to coast. We use proprietary health signals and personalized interactions to drive better health outcomes across the full continuum of care, at every stage in a person’s health journey. Teladoc Health leverages more than two decades of expertise and data-driven insights to meet Canada's growing needs.
Summary of PositionThe Senior Frontend Developer helps build responsive, high-quality applications across web and mobile. In this role, they’ll work hands-on with React and React Native, collaborating closely with product managers, designers, and engineers to turn ideas into functional products. They’ll bring experience building modern user interfaces, a commitment to quality, and the adaptability to work in an environment where requirements evolve and iteration is expected.
Their first mission is to join a team rebuilding our care delivery system from the ground up - across both mobile and web – using modern, cutting-edge technologies. From day one, they’ll contribute directly to shaping how users experience our platform. The work is highly visible and central to our success, with real impact on how thousands of people interact with care.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Build responsive user interfaces for web and mobile using React and React Native
Collaborate with product managers, designers, and engineers to explore ideas, shape requirements, and deliver functional prototypes
Integrate frontend components with backend APIs and services to deliver full functionality
Write and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure frontend reliability, usability, and performance across web and mobile
Debug, test, and refine code to support rapid iteration and continuous feedback
Implement frontend security best practices, including input validation, secure data handling, and collaboration with backend teams to protect user data
Ensure strong performance and compatibility across browsers and devices
Work with the existing component library, extending it where needed and contributing improvements back when appropriate
Interface with legacy systems when required to support integration or migration
Adapt to evolving technical directions, including working with other frontend frameworks as necessary
Prototype and test experimental features as part of an iterative, discovery-driven process
Help shape delivery workflows and contribute to evolving team practices and standards
Participate in planning, code reviews, and technical discussions
Maintain clear, concise documentation of components, decisions, and processes
Stay current with modern frontend tools and approaches, applying them where useful

Supervisory ResponsibilitiesNo
Qualifications Expected for PositionRequired:
Bachelor’s degree required (additional years of work experience may be substituted)
A minimum of 6 years of frontend software development experience
Strong proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and TypeScript with demonstrated expertise in React
Experience building mobile applications with React Native or similar cross-platform frameworks
Experience with state management solutions (Redux or similar)
Proven ability to build responsive, accessible interfaces that work across browsers and devices
Hands-on experience integrating frontend applications with backend APIs and services
Solid understanding of frontend testing practices, including unit, integration, and end-to-end testing
Familiarity with frontend security best practices, including input validation and secure data handling
Experience working with component libraries and design systems
Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with designers, product managers, and backend engineers
Comfort with ambiguity and evolving requirements in a fast-paced environment

Strongly Preferred:
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and frontend build tooling (Webpack or similar)
Prior work in regulated industries with compliance and data protection requirements

Nice to Have:
Familiarity with healthcare terminology standards (e.g., ICD-10)
Experience with healthcare data standards (FHIR, HL7v2, EMPI) and understanding of clinical/administrative workflows
Background in healthcare technology or care delivery organizations
Experience with accessibility standards (WCAG 2.2 or similar) and assistive technologies

Hourly Rate Range$57.69 to $72.12/hour
Position TypeNet New
